flags: Cache 00 calls Hooper’s Bald the highest point along the skyway; cache 01 places the road’s high point on Haw Knob’s slopes. Summit elevation and road elevation are kept distinct; the Hooper superlative is omitted.
Cache 01 and cache 08 disagree on Hooper Bald trailhead mile markers. No trailhead mile marker is given.

Cache 00 describes hemlocks and a broad trail network around Joyce Kilmer; cache 09 documents loss of giant eastern hemlocks. The story omits hemlocks and uses only the memorial forest’s two-mile loop.
Present trail descriptions rely on cached Wikipedia pages; no current land-manager trail-status page is supplied.

Cache 04 gives construction cost as over $100 million; cache 01 says about $100 million. The story follows the local tourism history in cache 04; its roughly 13-year delay remains attributed to Charles Hall.

Cache 11 describes the National Scenic Byway’s attractions but does not give a formal designation finding or intrinsic-quality category. The overview attributes its description to the national byway program without inventing a designation rationale. Cache 04 places the named skyway’s North Carolina beginning at Santeetlah Gap, 12 miles from Robbinsville; the closing drive distinguishes the onward NC 143 approach from that endpoint.
